About Deutsche Telekom Services Europe Romania
 In Romania, Deutsche Telekom has set up a Shared Service Center in Bucharest & Timisoara - Deutsche Telekom Services Europe Romania (DTSE Romania), which delivers support function services such as HR, Accounting, Reporting and Finance, as well as IT support services for these lines of business, for the whole European Deutsche Telekom footprint since July 2013.
 We Are Focused On
the best customer experiences
delivering high quality services
great working conditions
growing with innovations
continuously improving competitiveness through digitalization
 Responsibilities
Drive the digital transformation of Deutsche Telekom’s financial and planning processes through Jedox-based modeling and automation.
Translate business requirements into operational planning models and collaborates with controllers and stakeholders from Telekom Germany in agile sprints.
Contribute to the design of multidimensional data structures (dimensions, cubes, KPIs, business rules) and ETL processes to ensure accurate, automated data flows and consistent reporting standards.
Create front-end reports and dashboards in Jedox to simplify data collection and enable data-driven decision-making.
Oversee platform access management and content security of the platform
Coordinate with Jedox internal support, managing issue reporting and resolution
 Experience
Bachelor’s/master’s degree in Informatics, Business Informatics, Mathematics or a related degree
2+ years of relevant experience in Data Analytics, Controlling, Business Intelligence or related field
At least 1 year of experience working in Reporting and Planning software
Experience in OLAP databases or any multidimensional databases is beneficial
Language: Fluent written and spoken English, German skills nice to have
 Interpersonal Skills
Excellent teamwork and communication skills, high degree of customer and service orientation, organizational skills as well as initiative and decision-making competence
High sense of responsibility, flexibility and commitment even under great time pressure
Supports colleagues, encourages active cooperation, extroverted personality and high level tolerance
A high level of social and intercultural competence helps you to act with confidence in critical situations 
A thorough and methodical approach to work
